preservationRule: First failure records are additive and not rewritten after retest.

failures.actual: Initial launcher used a wrong working directory and did not start the intended Vite process.
failures.resolution: Corrected launcher pointed at the candidate worktree; Vite and Renderer CDP started.

failures.actual: E06-01/02/03 individual receipts passed; text preview assertion failed while first-run onboarding/Renderer ordinary-session selection was incomplete.
failures.resolution: Completed onboarding, selected the actual ordinary session in the Renderer, then verified Main read, Shadow DOM marker and review workbench return.

failures.actual: Onboarding was complete and Main authorized read passed, but the ordinary session created through IPC had not been selected in the live Renderer; preview marker was absent there.
failures.resolution: Selected the actual ordinary session through the Renderer and repeated the preview check successfully.

failures.actual: Synthetic C real provider Run persisted failed with zero checks; diagnostic reports one planned check unexecuted and Agent max-turn limit 24. This is not a business-non-compliant verdict.
failures.resolution: No repair/re-run performed; first failure retained pending proper original A/B/C pack and fault attribution.

failures.actual: Driver expected the review workbench while the live Renderer was on Batch Manager.
failures.resolution: Prepared a fresh synthetic case, opened the actual workbench and reran with the required fixed-SHA environment; the race scenario passed.

failures.actual: Selected case already had a completed Run, so Renderer showed Restart while the helper asserted Start. No business decision was made.
failures.resolution: Used a fresh case with zero prior Runs.

failures.actual: First fixture-generation attempt used a wrong object shape; subsequent attempt had invalid escaped newline and one run lacked required QA environment. Each original command/log is retained.
failures.resolution: Corrected synthetic fixture and environment; fresh-case race run passed.

failures.actual: PDF Main preparation, Renderer tab, iframe navigation and 432x576 canvas all passed; final helper assertion failed because it assumed a workbench tab from Batch Manager.
failures.resolution: Manual real Renderer retest clicked the actual review workbench and confirmed it visible; first helper failure preserved.

failures.actual: Initial cleanup selector matched three command lines and refused to signal any process. No target process was killed.
failures.resolution: Corrected selector required the exact candidate Electron executable and isolated runtime app path.

failures.actual: Initial validator compared an immutable pre-launch manifest to the mutable recovery profile after it had booted and written normal runtime state; 1383 expected differences. It did not modify the snapshot or live profile.
failures.resolution: Corrected validation to check the immutable pre-crash snapshot copy against its own manifest; every file hash matched.
